instruction: Use the opened OpenStudio application and its CLI/API automation interface to organize /home/user/Desktop/init.osm and save the updated model as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm. The operator needs an OpenStudio model that distinguishes public customer traffic, staff work patterns, kitchen equipment, and water use. Preserve the linear block massing and adjacency of uses while organizing space loads, outdoor air, window areas, kitchen water use, exterior walkway lighting, and end-use reporting. Deliver only the updated OpenStudio model file; object handles, serialization order, and automatically generated metadata may vary naturally.
